title: JVS Ticket App
tagline: Standalone issue/suggestion/enquiry ticket form for JVS Switchgears, with email routing and QR-code access.
description: A mobile-first ticket form built for JVS Switchgears, designed to be opened via QR code on the shop floor or by customers. Submissions (Issue / Suggestion / Enquiry) are emailed directly via SMTP to the company inbox, with an automatic copy sent back to the submitter. Each ticket gets a persistent YYYY-XXX number that survives redeploys. Supports multi-image upload from camera or gallery. No third-party form service is used — the entire backend is a self-hosted Node.js/Express app.
highlights: Standalone form — no Formspree or third-party form service
Persistent ticket numbering (YYYY-XXX), survives redeploys via mounted volume
Sends notification email to company inbox + auto-copy to submitter
Multi-image upload from camera or gallery (up to 10 files)
Mobile-first UI, designed for QR-code access
Fully containerized, deployed via Docker on Dokploy

restricted.label: Deployment credentials and submitted ticket data available on request
